name: Duskwell Mood Gels — Ease Coral
description: Coral-colored soft gels containing a proprietary blend of synth-adaptogens and low-level anxiolytic bioactive compounds, designed to produce a gentle 2-hour reduction in social anxiety without sedation. Companion product to the existing Calm Amber line.
flavor_profile: Lychee and white peach with a faint herbal undertone; smooth gel texture that dissolves quickly, leaving a clean mouth feel
slogan: Take the edge off. Keep the clarity.
cultural_context: The Ease line is quietly ubiquitous in Tier 2 social spaces — bars, community centers, transit hubs — with many users treating it as casually as an antacid; there is ongoing civic debate about whether bioactive candy should require a dispensary license.
story_hooks: A Tier 2 labor organizer discovers that Duskwell Ease Coral is being distributed free at company-sponsored events, raising questions about whether employers are chemically managing worker dissent.
The anxiolytic compound in Ease Coral interacts unexpectedly with a specific BCI firmware version, causing temporary memory fragmentation — and Duskwell knows.
A character addicted to escalating doses of Ease Coral must navigate a world that doesn't recognize bioactive candy as a dependency.
